description: This file defines the DocumentElements class, which manages a collection of document elements such as paragraphs, tables, legends, charts, images, and text frames within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes methods for adding various element types, cloning, serialization, and visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: DocumentElements
classes.description: Represents a collection of document elements in the MigraDoc document object model, providing methods to add, clone, serialize, and accept visitors for various document components.

classes.name: DocumentElements.DocumentElementsValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for DocumentElements.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph, optionally with specified text and style, to the document elements collection.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.description: Adds a new table to the collection.

methods.name: AddLegend
methods.description: Adds a new legend element to the collection.

methods.name: AddPageBreak
methods.description: Inserts a manual page break into the document elements.

methods.name: AddBarcode
methods.description: Adds a barcode element to the collection.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Creates and adds a chart with a specified type to the collection.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image with a given name to the collection.

methods.name: AddTextFrame
methods.description: Adds a text frame to the collection.
